name: Dau phu nhoi hau
summary: Đậu phụ nhồi hàu is tofu stuffed with oyster, named by the national tourism authority as a dish made from Đầm Lập An oysters. The article does not print a recipe.

howToEat: Order it at the lagoon. The article does not name a shop or a filling.

where: Đầm Lập An. No street number is printed.
